profile.headline: Web Developer at Leyline
profile.summary: I'm a recent graduate of California State University, Fullerton with a degree in Computer Science. I am a strong independent programmer but I am also able to adapt into a team environment. As a first generation college graduate, I am extremely motivated and always ready to push myself. My main interests lie in Software Engineering and Cybersecurity.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
Created magic moments, provided exceptional guest service to people from around the world, restocked work location, and managed overflowing queues.
Collaborated as a team in a constantly crowded atmosphere.
Responsible for daily leadership roles; assigned roles to others and handled currency.
Achieved guest compliments for extraordinary guest satisfaction.

positions.title: Host
positions.description: Communicated between guests and server, seated and interacted with guests. Help the servers when busy, cashed, and managed queue. Took phone calls and to-go orders. Trained new hires to perform and exceed work expectations.

positions.title: Car Wash Employee
positions.description:
Set-up work location, took care of customers belongings and organized all keys with appropriate customers, washed  and cleaned interior and exterior of various types of vehicles (cars, trucks, trailers, RVs, etc…)
Handled transactions.

projects.title: Instagram Bot
projects.description: Simple Instagram Bot to interact with Instagram to perform automated tasks faster than a human. Coded in Python and understanding the library Selenium. Also running on Chrome browser, therefore installing ChromeDrive and understanding documentation.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: I researched and read how to program in HTML, Javascript, and CSS to build my own personal website. I also used a raspberry pi to host my website. May also reconsider to host my website on AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
